name: Grand Hotel Tynemouth
accommodation: Hotel rooms including standard, premium and sea-view rooms
suitableFor: Couples and anyone wanting a hotel stay right on Longsands
confirmedFeatures: Brasserie, afternoon tea, weddings and private functions, online booking
overview: A landmark hotel on Grand Parade that looks straight out over Longsands. It offers modern rooms, some with sea views, alongside a brasserie and afternoon tea service. Tynemouth's Front Street and the priory are a short walk away, so you can check the surf from the window and still be close to the village's cafés and pubs.
surfTripFit: You are directly above Longsands, so checking conditions and getting in the water takes minutes.
